pieces.title: Fade Into a Smile
pieces.blurb: A barbershop from the first clipper pass to the mirror at the end. Shot handheld on the floor of the studio, cut to the rhythm of the room rather than a voiceover.

pieces.title: Protecting Me
pieces.blurb: Two mirrors carried onto an empty beach and left standing in the sand. Graded high and open, so the sea and the sky sit almost on the same white.

pieces.title: Social Cut
pieces.blurb: The same chair, cut for a phone. Tight on the hands and the product, built to hold a thumb for thirty seconds.
